propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit one deterministic canonical pin for each direct child and normalized prerequisite, sorted lexicographically by role then ID.
Plan material pins must appear in the deterministic manifest after verified-at-sha and before dep lines, containing role, canonical ticket ID, and exact 16-lowercase-hex material fingerprint.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide (including archived) and discover outbound depends_on and inbound blocks before any LLM evaluation, raising PlanRelationSnapshotError with exact reason enum before unsigned INDETERMINATE is returned.
tracker_head_sha() must verify the tickets tracker is clean (no staged, uncommitted, or unmerged files) and return its 40-hex HEAD SHA, mapping all git/IO/path failures to store-read-failure reason.

Ordinary sign, progressive drift refresh, and re-sign plan review paths must all call collect_plan_relation_snapshot and pass complete pins to build_manifest, with deleted targets causing unsigned INDETERMINATE missing-target remediation.

Legacy manifests without pins must remain readable; new readers must authenticate the complete stored DSSE manifest including unknown pin lines, then ignore those lines for field interpretation without reconstruction.
